properties.name: Larimer County Canal 2
properties.note: Larimer County Canal 2 seems to be proper name.  Sometimes called Mail Creek Ditch as well, but it's unclear this is correct.  South of the pond just to the south east where a ditch breaks off of Mail Creek is unambiguously Mail Creek Ditch.

properties.name: Farmers Ditch
properties.note: The path Farmers Ditch under the shopping center is a wild guess based on USGS Topo in the past. Farmers Ditch has to still be there somewhere for water drainage/irrigation.  Please update when more data is known.
